notes: IBM's CICS asynchronous API credit-card example: CSSTATS2 (the customer-status service ASYNCPNT starts in parallel, transaction STUS). GET CONTAINER(INPUTCONTAINER); RUN TRANSID(GETP) CHILD and RUN TRANSID(SPND) CHILD (no CHANNEL; it never FETCHes them, so their outcome cannot reach this task -- the children are not run here, the RUN commands are compared); '0001' is 'VERY VIP', any other 'REGULAR '; PUT CONTAINER(GETVIPSTATUS); RETURN. The region's transactions are the bundle's ("transactions": etc/CICS_bundles/cics-async-creditcardapplication-resources/*.transaction: the bundle's nine TRANSACTION definitions (GETP runs GETPOL, SPND runs GETSPND)). Its LINKAGE SECTION is empty: no COMMAREA ("commarea": null). The task starts with the channel its caller passes (#4270, oracle_assumptions.md X24): MYCHANNEL holding INPUTCONTAINER, the 4-byte account number ASYNCPNT / SEQPNT PUT there (no DATATYPE: BIT). The containers the task leaves on MYCHANNEL are compared at its end, as the caller sees them after FETCH CHILD / its LINK. scenarios.name: account-0001
scenarios.why: '0001': RUN GETP and RUN SPND NORMAL (both defined), 'VERY VIP' into GETVIPSTATUS

scenarios.name: no-channel
scenarios.why: no channel: GET CONTAINER without CHANNEL has no current channel -- INVREQ RESP2 4 (caught by RESP), ACCOUNT-NUMBER-IN keeps its initial value (no VALUE clause: oracle_assumptions.md L3) so the ELSE branch runs; PUT CONTAINER is INVREQ RESP2 4 too, then RETURN; there is no channel, so nothing more to compare
